summary: Comprehensive testing completed for GreenGold Grocers multi-page landing website. Backend API mostly functional with one validation issue. Frontend fully functional with excellent navigation, form handling, and responsive design.

validation_issues.issue: Backend accepts invalid form data without validation
validation_issues.impact: Invalid enquiries (empty name, invalid email, short phone) are saved to database
validation_issues.details: Should return 422 for validation errors but returns 200

design_issues.issue: 2 broken product images detected on Products page

passed_tests: Home page loads with hero section and CTA buttons
Navigation between all 4 pages works correctly
About page displays mission, vision, and brand story
Products page shows product grid with functional category filtering
All 5 category filters work correctly (All, Atta & Whole Grains, Healthy Cereals, Superfoods, Natural Grocery)
Enquiry form frontend validation works properly
Valid enquiry form submission to /api/enquiry endpoint
Success message displays after form submission
Form fields clear after successful submission
Footer displays on all pages with contact information
Typography correctly uses Playfair Display for headings
Color scheme matches green and white organic theme (#14532D, #D6EFD8, #FDFBF7)
All main images load correctly except 2 product images
action_item_for_main_agent: Add backend validation for enquiry form to match frontend validation (name, email format, 10-digit phone). Fix 2 broken product images on Products page.
